rows.note: This is the all-purpose modern Cantonese term for the semiconductor device.

example.english: A transistor can be used to amplify sound.
example.traditional: 電晶體可以用嚟放大聲音。
example.jyutping: din6 zing1 tai2 ho2 ji5 jung6 lei4 fong3 daai6 seng1 jam1

rows.note: Use this colloquial, older Hong Kong term in informal speech for the component.

example.english: When the transistor broke, the radio had no sound.
example.traditional: 原子粒壞咗，部收音機就冇聲。
example.jyutping: jyun4 zi2 nap1 waai6 zo2 bou6 sau1 jam1 gei1 zau6 mou5 seng1

rows.note: Use this technical written variant in manuals or contexts influenced by Mainland or Taiwan terminology.

example.english: The manual says that the transistor on this circuit board is responsible for stabilizing the voltage.
example.traditional: 說明書指出，呢塊電路板上嘅晶體管負責穩定電壓。
example.jyutping: syut3 ming4 syu1 zi2 ceot1 ne1 faai3 din6 lou6 baan2 soeng6 ge3 zing1 tai2 gun2 fu6 zaak3 wan2 ding6 din6 aat3
